test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence that brings out the most appropriate meaning of the idiom

‘Dog in the manger’.

options.text: Rachit had some important work and so he cancelled the show tickets for everyone.
Mohit was so loyal and committed to his company that he rejected lucrative offers from different companies.
You are here just because you have recognised your hidden potential.
To prove this is not a trap, I want to check the credibility of your plan.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Dog in the manger"** refers to a person **who prevents others from enjoying something despite not being able to use it themselves. (स्वयं उपयोग ना करते हुए दूसरों को ना करने देना)**

 
 
• **Example: **John was acting like a **dog in the manger** by not letting anyone else use the ball he wasn't playing with.
 
 
 
• **Explanation of Option 1:** Rachit cancelled the show tickets for everyone even though he had important work and couldn't attend himself. (रचित ने महत्वपूर्ण काम होने के कारण सभी के शो के टिकट रद्द कर दिए)
 
 
• **Example: **Rachit's cancellation of the tickets exemplifies the** "dog in the manger" **behavior as he prevented others from enjoying the show.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 2: **Mohit was so loyal and committed to his company that he rejected lucrative offers from different companies. (मोहित अपनी कंपनी के प्रति इतना वफादार और प्रतिबद्ध था कि उसने विभिन्न कंपनियों के आकर्षक प्रस्तावों को ठुकरा दिया)

 
 
• **Example:** Mohit's loyalty does not exemplify the **"dog in the manger" **idiom.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** You are here just because you have recognised your hidden potential. (आप यहां केवल इसलिए हैं क्योंकि आपने अपनी छिपी हुई क्षमता को पहचाना है)
 
 
• **Example:** Recognizing one's potential is unrelated to the** "dog in the manger" **idiom.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** To prove this is not a trap, I want to check the credibility of your plan. (यह साबित करने के लिए कि यह जाल नहीं है, मैं आपकी योजना की विश्वसनीयता की जांच करना चाहता हूं)
 
 
• **Example:** Checking the credibility of a plan is not related to the **"dog in the manger"** idiom.
 
 

45:Tb1e,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
